title: Freeze independent CCP2 corpus before production
description:
Scope: the CCP2 release manifest, revision/digests and language-neutral consumer contract in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/, with release references in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Freeze the exact candidate snapshot approved by the completed independence/schema/completeness audit and publish its expected per-language case inventory and operation/outcome contract. Verify that bytes, schemas and contract references still match the audited snapshot; any drift requires renewed audit before release. This release unit does not repeat the audit, implement production adapters or wait for consumer/integration/RF completion.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: The surviving x7hh.6.3 parent contains a separate pre-release audit and this release/digest gate. Concrete production leaves continue to depend on vectors.11; actual consumers remain under language parents and vectors.15 remains under joined CI. Never add a dependency back to those consumers or to any rollup.
acceptance_criteria: The released corpus has an unambiguous revision, immutable digests, exact-wire reference and complete consumer contract matching the clean audit artifact. File, schema and case inventories compare exactly to the audited snapshot; no post-audit expected-value change is silently frozen. All active operation kinds, applicable language case sets and independent expected outcomes are specified without requiring future API results. Release references/check commands resolve, preserved legacy bytes remain unchanged, and the freeze completes before any new Python/Rust/C production leaf begins. No deployment or production-consumer completion claim is made.
